{"id":2,"question":"What is the difference between .NET Framework and .NET Core?","answer":".NET Framework is Windows-only and has been around since 2002. .NET Core (now just .NET 5+) is cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macOS), open-source, and optimized for modern cloud-based applications. .NET Core has better performance, supports side-by-side versioning, and is the future of the .NET platform.","category":".NET Core","tags":["dotnet","framework","cross-platform"],"difficulty":"Medium","dateAdded":"2026-01-16T17:46:45.964Z","expanded":false}
